The `topology_boundary_auditor` provided a high-confidence mask, but the visual evidence of the mask shows jagged, noisy edges around the foreground figures, confirming the Router's observation of blending/fusion issues. The Router underestimated the severity of the foreground figures; they appear to be AI hallucinations with indistinct anatomy (are they sitting? how many limbs?), which constitutes a significant structural artifact (severity ~3.0) even if the bus itself is clean. The side mirror fusion is a classic AI artifact (severity 2.0).

The image is a strong representation of the class despite the strange foreground elements.
